title: haworthia × tortuosa
intro: Haworthia × tortuosa, commonly known as the Tortuous Haworthia or Tortuous Zebra Plant, is a rare and unique succulent plant hybrid that is a cross between Haworthia fasciata and Haworthia limifolia. This plant is known for its striking, wavy leaves with distinctive zebra-like patterns, making it a sought-after ornamental addition to any indoor space. The health benefits of Haworthia × tortuosa include its potential to reduce stress and anxiety, improve air quality by removing toxins, and promote a good night's sleep. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and saponins, which are believed to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, and therapeutic actions such as sedation and relaxation.
